The government has started repairing and rebuilding suspension bridges damaged by the Bhote Koshi flood in Nuwakot and Dhading, reconnecting communities separated by the disaster. Out of 64 suspension bridges from Muglin to Timure, 53 were damaged. Of these, 20 require repairs and 33 need reconstruction. Repair work has already started on five bridges: Mahesh Dovan–Mastar, Kalikathan, Malinga–Majhuwa Taar, Kewreni–Gahate and Pimaltaar–Jagaram Khola. The government aims to complete these repairs within one month. Tenders have also been invited to rebuild the remaining 33 bridges. Once restored, the bridges are expected to improve access to markets, schools, health facilities and essential services for flood-affected communities. #nepalinlast24hours
